attack_title: BLS You: A Zero-Query Rogue-Key Forgery Against the 2P-AISO-AS Chosen-Key Interface
attack_result: Public-key-only, zero-signing-query fresh-message forgery against the direct-addition BLS instantiation of the chosen-key DS2 interface in Definition 33
attack_technique: After the honest key is revealed, register the valid subgroup point X_E=beta*P-X_A so direct-addition aggregation equals beta*P, then output beta*H(m*) on a never-queried message

history_evidence.preferred_wording: The candidate forgery applies the standard BLS rogue-public-key cancellation attack to the chosen-key DS2 interface in Definition 33 of ePrint 2026/1394. No prior public report applying this attack to that exact target was located in the searches performed as of 18 October 2026.

post_reproduction_delta.publication_wording: Against the Definition 33 chosen-key DS2 interface of ePrint 2026/1394, we apply the standard BLS rogue-public-key cancellation attack and obtain a zero-query fresh-message forgery at full BLS12-381 parameters. We located no earlier public report applying this attack to that exact interface in searches completed through 18 October 2026. The attack technique is prior art; no technique novelty is claimed.

scope_limitations: The qualifying target is the direct-addition BLS instantiation of the chosen-key DS2 interface in Definition 33 only.
The result does not refute Theorem 1 and is not an attack on Figure 6, central honest KeyGen, a proper DKG, the artifact's normal application lifecycle, or any deployment.
The adversary does not know the discrete logarithm of the rogue key and does not need it because Definition 33 requires no proof of possession or secret-key knowledge.
The attack does not apply when a valid proof of possession, key-binding coefficient, public-key message augmentation, or suitable DKG ownership check is enforced.
The attack-history statement is bounded to public material located through 18 October 2026.
repair_directions: verified proof of possession or secret-key knowledge
authenticated honest generation or a proper DKG with contribution ownership binding
